description: Defines the NetworkChangeNotifierPassive class, a subclass of NetworkChangeNotifier, which handles network change notifications in a passive manner for platforms like ChromeOS, Lacros, Android, and Linux. It includes methods for updating network state and internal mechanisms for managing network change signals.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierPassive
classes.description: A passive network change notifier that updates network state based on external notifications, primarily used on platforms with restricted network change listening capabilities.

methods.name: OnDNSChanged
methods.description: Notify that DNS configuration has changed.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Notify that IP address has changed.

methods.name: OnConnectionChanged
methods.description: Notify that the connection type has changed.

methods.name: OnConnectionSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Notify that the connection subtype has changed.

methods.name: GetCurrentMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Get the maximum bandwidth and connection type.
